configure_cascade_roi_heads: configure CascadeROIHeads with 3 stages for 1203 LVIS classes using ViTDet backbone
set_box_heads: set up three FastRCNNConvFCHead instances with 256-channel conv layers and layer normalization
set_box_predictors: configure FastRCNNOutputLayers with fed loss, sigmoid CE, and increasing B2B transform weights
set_proposal_matchers: create three Matcher instances with escalating IoU thresholds of 0.5, 0.6, and 0.7
override_base_config: override the base Mask R-CNN config by removing single-stage box head and predictor keys
